WALK-IN INTERVIEW

Walk-in Interview is going to be held for the engagement of following posts at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Regional Office, Hyderabad. The candidates are required to attend the Walk-in interview on 12th April 2018. The candidates should produce original copies of all educational certificates and other documentary proofs at the time of interview. The engagements will be made purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, which may be extended based on evaluation of their performance.
